name: TR-Gaussians
definition: A 3D Gaussian-based representation for high-fidelity rendering of planar transmission and reflection in indoor scenes, combining 3D Gaussians with learnable reflection planes to explicitly model glass planes with view-dependent reflectance strengths.
summary: TR-Gaussians is a 3D Gaussian Splatting method that explicitly decomposes scenes into real transmission and virtual reflection geometry using a learnable plane to prevent artifacts in novel views.
